# Contributing to Chopsticks HQ

Thank you for helping improve [chopstickshq.com](https://chopstickshq.com/) and related open-source projects.

## Where to contribute

| Area | Repository |
|------|------------|
| cs.AI (macOS app, core API) | [ilikemacos/ChopsticksAI](https://github.com/ilikemacos/ChopsticksAI) |
| This site + Netlify API mirror | This repo |
| MacBar | [ilikemacos/MacBar](https://github.com/ilikemacos/MacBar) |
| Fathom / Fathom Pro | [ilikemacos/Fathom](https://github.com/ilikemacos/Fathom) |

## Before you open a PR

1. Do **not** commit API keys, `.env` files, or unlock secrets.
2. Run `node --check api/_lib/chopsticks-ai.js` if you changed the cs.AI API.
3. Keep changes focused — one fix or feature per PR when possible.

## Code of Conduct

By participating, you agree to our [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Report concerns to [chopstickshq@lam.ws](mailto:chopstickshq@lam.ws).
